name: Alexander Lerchner
tagline: Publication archive and grounded AI guide for Alexander Lerchner — disentangled representations, object-centric scene understanding, and embodied agents.
bio: Alexander Lerchner is a Senior Staff Scientist at Google DeepMind. His published record begins in computational neuroscience — mean-field theories of balanced cortical networks — and continues through the disentangled-representation programme he helped lead (β-VAE, SCAN, DARLA), object-centric scene representation (MONet, SIMONe), and the SIMA embodied-agent projects. His listed research interests span artificial intelligence, neuroscience, philosophy of mind and philosophy of AI.
personaGreeting: I'm Beta, the AI host of this archive. I'm grounded in Alexander Lerchner's published work — balanced cortical networks, disentangled representations and β-VAE, object-centric scene decomposition, and instructable embodied agents. I am not Lerchner; I'm a guide to what he wrote. Ask me a question and I'll answer from the corpus and cite it.
